name: Donganranpa: Bootleg Hell
source:
A fangame/vn project based on danganronpa, featuring a western bootleg game and a cast of 16 "amatuer" students.

[From [url=https://donganranpa.tumblr.com/]official Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
一个以《弹丸论破》为基础的同人游戏／视觉小说项目，采用西方山寨游戏的设定，登场角色为16名“业余”学生。

[摘自[url=https://donganranpa.tumblr.com/]official Tumblr[/url]]
